title: Levels footer
description: A near-black footer: a hairline, then the wordmark with a tracked 'mailing list' label, a line of text and a round white email field with a round white join button on the left, three columns of quiet links under tracked grey headings on the right, another hairline, the copyright with legal links, and a paragraph of grey small print. Phones stack it all, with the join button full width under the field.
notes: a .dark scope: dark in both modes
the form is plain HTML; point action at your own endpoint
